 {"step":2,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse","line":595,"var":"ctb","code":"ctb = iobuf_get (inp)","note":"The parser reads the first byte as the packet tag from the attacker input."},

 {"step":4,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse","line":621,"var":"pkttype","code":"pkttype = ctb & 0x3f","note":"The low bits make the packet type 12, which dispatches to the comment-packet handler."},
 {"step":5,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse","line":638,"var":"pktlen","code":"pktlen = c","note":"The length byte is decoded as zero, so the comment packet has an empty body."},
 {"step":6,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse_comment","line":3020,"var":"packet->pkt.comment","code":"packet->pkt.comment = xmalloc (sizeof *packet->pkt.comment + pktlen - 1)","note":"The code subtracts 1 from an unsigned length of 0, producing a huge allocation size and triggering the memory-safety bug when the parser allocates the comment packet."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
